decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal, by reason of failing to provide acceptable,
private rear amenity space, would result in a poor standard of living
accommodation for future occupiers of this flat, to the detriment of their
residential amenities, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework
(2023), Policies D6 and D3.D7 of The London Plan (2021), Policies DM1 and DM26
of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), The&nbsp; Mayor of London Housing Supplementary Planning
Guidance (2016), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential
Design Guide (2010) and Housing Design Standards LPG (2023).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The applicant has failed to provide plans which show any proposed
parking on the site. The proposed scheme would therefore be unfeasible and
would provide an insufficient on-site parking provision contrary to the high-quality
design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policy T6
of the London Plan (2021), Policy DM42 of the Development Management Policies
Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential
Design Guide (2010).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The plans submitted omit the existing outbuilding and no
information has been provided regarding the rear and front amenity space from
the existing and proposed plans, showing an inaccurate layout of the site and failing
to accurately show the relationship between the units and the site. The site
also appears to host a self-contained unit within the outbuilding which does
not appear to be lawful. As such, the local planning authority is therefore
unable to make a comprehensive and objective assessment of the proposed
development in relation to the impact to future residents amenities, contrary
to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3.D7 of The
London Plan (2021), Policies DM1, DM26 and DM27 of the Development Management
Policies Local Plan (2013), The&nbsp; Mayor of
London Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016), the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Housing
Design Standards LPG (2023).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal development fails to provide refuse and waste recycling bins and bicycle stores result in a detriment to the character and fails to to promote sustainable transport, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Core Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core
Strategy, Policies D3.D1, D3.D11 and T5 of The London Plan (2021), Policies
DM1, DM26, DM23, DM42 and DM45 of the Development Management Policies Local
Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design
Guide (2010).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposed development provides a substandard level of habitable accommodation by reason of the unacceptable quantum of internal floorspace for flat 2, lack of external amenity space and poor mitigation for noise transfer between units. As such, the proposed development would result in
a substandard form of development to the detriment of their
future amenities, contrary to the high-quality design aspirations of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3.D7 of The London
Plan (2021), Policies DM1, DM26 and DM27 of the Development Management Policies
Local Plan (2013), The&nbsp; Mayor of London
Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016), the adopted Supplementary
Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Housing Design Standards
LPG (2023).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p>The proposed development seek a primary access to the proposed self-contained upper floor flat via an entrance off land not in the applicants red line area and thereby control. As such the development is contrary to Policy DM1 of the Harrow development Management policies (2013).&nbsp;</p>
description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (2 X 2 bed); external alterations
